caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with a half-round drop-leaf design. The tabletop has a smooth surface with rounded edges, and one leaf is in a downward position while the other side appears fixed or upright. The table is supported by six intricately turned legs connected by stretchers, featuring spindle-shaped elements. The entire drawing is rendered in shades of gray and black penciling on a plain light-colored background. There are no objects on or around the table. Two names, "D. DONOVAN" and "J.F. McCARTHY," are handwritten beneath the table near the bottom edge of the drawing.
title: Gate-leg Table
